title: Sparkly magnifying glass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='lensGrad' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#bfe8ff'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#7ec8e3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4a9fc0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='66' y='62' width='10' height='26' rx='4' fill='#c47a3a' transform='rotate(-45 71 75)'/>
  <rect x='68' y='64' width='4' height='22' rx='2' fill='#e8a662' transform='rotate(-45 71 75)'/>
  <!-- handle end cap -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='82' r='4.5' fill='#a05a20'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='82' r='2' fill='#e8a662'/>
  <!-- lens rim -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='26' fill='#5a8fa8' stroke='#8ec4dc' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- lens inner rim highlight -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='22' fill='none' stroke='#3a7a96' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- lens glass -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='21' fill='url(#lensGrad)'/>
  <!-- glass shine -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='31' rx='9' ry='5.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.55' transform='rotate(-30 33 31)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <!-- sparkle 1 top right -->
    <path d='M80 20 L82 27 L89 29 L82 31 L80 38 L78 31 L71 29 L78 27 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle 2 left -->
    <path d='M12 30 L13.5 35 L18 36.5 L13.5 38 L12 43 L10.5 38 L6 36.5 L10.5 35 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle 3 bottom -->
    <path d='M30 82 L31.2 86 L35 87.2 L31.2 88.4 L30 92 L28.8 88.4 L25 87.2 L28.8 86 Z'/>
    <!-- small sparkle dots -->
    <circle cx='88' cy='48' r='2.2'/>
    <circle cx='20' cy='58' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='16' r='1.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
